# Universe24

> One line of whole-number arithmetic on a cubic lattice of Nodes, Rule3 in the law's flux form, read through clicks: the formulas it shares with nature and adds. A paper archived on Zenodo and at the tag v1.1.0, its supplement with every proof, the law of the lattice, the derivations as scripts, the engine of one Node with its tests and the paper's engine at the tag v1.1.0, and the tests of the law's course, Universe24 the main one: the one Node's world on the torus with light, matter and its click, run through its cycle and read on the lattice and by its one-way clock (examples/events/universe24/). Author: Alon Gonen, independent researcher, Haifa, Israel (ORCID 0009-0008-2701-4599). Licence MIT. Permanent record: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23466436 (the concept DOI of the releases from 3.0.0 on, resolving to the latest version; the versions 1.1.0 to 2.1.0 under https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23190113); the current software version, 3.0.0: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23466437

## In plain words

Suppose nature is discrete: space is made of Nodes, and between one Node and the next nothing moves faster than light. A cubic centimetre then holds an astronomical number of Nodes, so no centre can know and decide for all of them; each Node acts on its own, by a rule of its own, seeing only itself and its six neighbours. Universe24 is that rule: one line of whole-number arithmetic with no free number but the declared pairs, the level weight and the vacuum content. A Node holds, for every line of a field, its level now, its level one interval before, and a remainder; at every interval it forms one sum, twice its level now less its level before at the wall, plus what crosses its six Links at each Link's reach, less its own mass term, zero for light, plus the carried remainder, and divides by the wall; the quotient is its next level and the new remainder is kept. Nothing is lost, so the rule is exactly reversible. The rule is on whole numbers of any size and carries no bound; the bound is the engine's, from the width of its integers. The tick is the count of rounds and no Node reads it. The reach of a Link comes from the family's pair of integers, the Node's paces and the Link's tension, the mass of a Node from the pair and the paces; at the vacuum's paces the rule is a discrete wave equation, and from it the paper derives formulas that nature shows and adds formulas of its own with blind predictions. The flux form names a linear sum the lattice keeps for light, at one content, on a board that wraps on every axis, moved otherwise by named terms alone, and gives a lattice Gauss law: where the field stands, gravity's flux through a closed surface is minus the write it encloses, exact to the integer; where it moves, the flux exceeds the write by a quadratic in the field's own motion, sign-definite in the bulk up to an end term of either sign. A body sources gravity with its form, resists with its count and falls with its tail; for a cloud the law's line reads the three as one to the order (C / Gamma)^2, and for collapsed matter they part by the binding; the equivalence principle as a symmetry of the law, the same clock and the same ruler, follows from the composition of the paces, derived, while the three masses' agreement is the law's decision read on two clouds. A world is read only through clicks of declared counting regions. The paper's one claim: the rule helps compute things in nature. Every number in the paper is reproduced by a script in the repository.

## Read first

- [The paper, 40 pages](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/papers/one_rule/Universe24_Paper.pdf): "Universe24: one simple rule, the formulas it shares with nature and adds" (Alon Gonen, 2026)
- [The supplement, Online Resource 1, 85 pages](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/papers/one_rule/Universe24_Supplement.pdf): the claims list and the algebraic steps of every derivation
- [The time paper, 22 pages](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/papers/spacetime_events/Universe24_Discrete_Spacetime_of_Events_Paper.pdf): "A discrete spacetime of events in whole numbers: why clocks slow, why nothing outruns light, and why time has a direction only where something was measured" (Alon Gonen, 2026), its source, run and checks in papers/spacetime_events/, built and run by its build.sh
- [README](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/README.md): the aim, the plain words, the one Node, the tests of the law's course with Universe24 the main one and what its page shows, what the repository holds, how to run a world, what is open

## The documents

- [The law of the lattice](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/docs/ALGEBRA.md): one algebraic line per rule, the families, the bodies, the clicks, every shipped world's formula and blind expectation, the one Node and the swap at the top
- [The decisions in force](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/docs/HIGHLIGHTS.md): one line each
- [Further research](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/docs/FURTHER_RESEARCH.md): every open thing by name, what nature shows, what the law has, what is missing, where to start and, where a local study exists, what was checked locally on 2026-10-17
- [Follow-up papers](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/docs/FOLLOW_UP_PAPERS.md): the papers the project proposes next, from the careful to the bold, each with its one question, what the project has in the law's status words, and the run or derivation it needs
- [The engine](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/docs/ENGINE.md): the words, the main loop and Rule3 in the law's flux form with the interval's five acts, the files, the output, the gates, how to run and how to build a world, the known issues and the open items
- [Contributing](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/CONTRIBUTING.md): forks and pull requests, the ground rules, the checks, how to report an error or a failed reproduction
- [The claims map](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/docs/CLAIMS.md): every theorem, identity and quantitative claim of the proofs' inventory as one row, its place, statement, ground, kind, verdict and the function that checks it, generated from the proofs inventory
- [Errata](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/docs/ERRATA.md): the findings in the text and what was done about them, with the commits and the versions of record
- [What changed](https://closer24.github.io/Universe24/CHANGELOG.md): one entry per version, 3.0.0 the click as one act, the spin and the atom, 2.1.0 the step in the law's flux form, 2.0.0 the engine V2 against 1.1.0, the paper's engine; the Unreleased entry of the branch one-universe (2026-10-23), the one Node, the board a torus, the swap at the top, the window derived, the stress the Links', the frame clause and Universe24, with the day's branches before it

## The code

- [Repository on GitHub](https://github.com/Closer24/Universe24): the derivations as scripts (tools/derivations/), the implementation (src/event_universe/), the tests, the tests of the law's course under examples/events/ with Universe24 (examples/events/universe24/) and the two slits' universe (examples/events/two_slits/)
- [Zenodo record](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23466436): the concept DOI of the releases from 3.0.0 on, the permanent record and the one to cite, resolving to the latest version (the versions 1.1.0 to 2.1.0 under [10.5281/zenodo.23190113](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23190113)); the current software version, 4.0.0, the tag v4.0.0 (2026-10-25, the one Node's world Universe24 with the families and the parameters declared, no Zenodo record), after 3.0.0, the click as one act, the spin and the atom, the version record [10.5281/zenodo.23466437](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23466437); the paper's engine, version 1.1.0, is 10.5281/zenodo.23202100
